target_customer: Procurement and supply chain teams at manufacturers buying direct materials (robotics, industrial equipment, medical devices, biotech instruments, automotive).
problem: Procurement staff spend their time chasing RFQ quotes, PO confirmations and delivery updates by email and spreadsheet instead of sourcing.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI procurement agents layered on ERP, email and Excel (pricing not public)
product_category: AI agents for procurement and supply chain execution

founders.name: Sam Lamba
education: Duke University, Electrical and Computer Engineering and Computer Science degree
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led AI-driven products at Google and holds two AI patents.

founders.name: Eshani Mehta
founders.background_notes: Led payments intelligence products at Stripe per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents that parse quotes from PDFs, spreadsheets and emails and sync with ERPs such as SAP, NetSuite and Oracle. Standard agent engineering plus hard integration work for a team of two founders in 2025.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and supplier communication history add some lock-in, but the agent layer was copyable and several procurement AI vendors existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy of the wedge found as of 2026-11; search results showed other procurement AI startups raising seed rounds in late 2025.

market_need_then: Direct materials procurement is run on email and spreadsheets. The company's site cites customers OFS, Carbon Robotics and Ultima Genomics reporting faster RFQ handling (customer reported).

branding.domain_note: Company site is lumari.ai; some aggregators list lumari.io. History not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, workflow focused product copy (company site).

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand. Name is a short coined word; several unrelated LUMARI trademark filings exist.

outcome_analysis: Lumari is a very early Spring 2025 YC company with named industrial customers on its site and ex Google, Stripe and Tesla founders. No funding round, exit or distress is publicly documented as of November 2026, so the outcome is unknown and early.
notes: Aggregators (altss, zerogtalent, welcome.ai) list about 500K pre-seed in June 2025; unverified, single aggregator type, so not recorded as a round. Caplight headline about a 16M Series A is unrelated. Procure AI (13M seed) and Lio (30M) are different companies. YC page says team of 3 while directory says 5. No dated competitor sources found near the batch, so the list is empty; Pactum, Keelvar, Zip and GEP exist per undated pages. Completeness pass: Pre-seed of about $500K dated June 2025 rests on a single aggregator (altss); other listings give the $500K total without date or type. Investors not stated by the source. Cross-check search found no press release.
